import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def signals(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """DRY RUN relabel of DEAD_LIST row 6. Fade a 'forced-deleverage exhaustion bar':
    true range >= 3x rolling-48 median TR, volume >= 3x rolling-48 median volume,
    close in the bottom 20% of the bar's range -> +1 (fade down-cascade),
    close in the top 20% -> -1 (fade up-cascade). Closed bars only; rolling windows
    use only the current and prior bars (no negative shifts)."""
    o = df['open'].astype(float)
    h = df['high'].astype(float)
    l = df['low'].astype(float)
    c = df['close'].astype(float)
    v = df['volume'].astype(float)
    prev_c = c.shift(1)
    tr = pd.concat([h - l, (h - prev_c).abs(), (l - prev_c).abs()], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    tr_med = tr.rolling(48, min_periods=48).median()
    v_med = v.rolling(48, min_periods=48).median()
    rng = (h - l).replace(0, np.nan)
    pos = (c - l) / rng
    big = (tr >= 3.0 * tr_med) & (v >= 3.0 * v_med)
    down_cascade = big & (c < o) & (pos <= 0.20)
    up_cascade = big & (c > o) & (pos >= 0.80)
    sig = pd.Series(0, index=df.index, dtype='int64')
    sig[down_cascade.fillna(False)] = 1
    sig[up_cascade.fillna(False)] = -1
    return sig
